complexity.notes: Correctness relies on the problem's guarantee that strings contain only ASCII characters, so the emoji delimiter can never collide with content; this does not satisfy the follow-up asking for a character-set-agnostic algorithm (a length-prefixed encoding would). Also, decode() depends on encode() always appending a trailing delimiter, which happens to make the empty-list case work, but the coupling is implicit and a bit fragile.
complexity.summary: Encodes by joining the strings with a non-ASCII emoji delimiter (plus a trailing delimiter) and decodes by splitting on that delimiter and dropping the trailing empty segment. Both operations are linear in the total character volume.
